cards.title: Your Workstation
cards.description: Three monitors. Cold coffee. A red notification flashes: HKEX circular received.
cards.image_prompt: A corporate office workstation with three monitors, one flashing red. Cold coffee cup, Post-it notes. Secure door with keycard reader to the left. Warm fluorescent lighting, tense deadline atmosphere.

cards.title: HKEX Circular
cards.description: HKEX/RC-2026-017 — 3 chapters amended. Effective 12 May. 4 key changes.

cards.title: Compliance Vault
cards.description: Filing cabinets. A scrambled process flow on the display. Cabinet B is ajar.
cards.image_prompt: A secure corporate vault room with tall metal filing cabinets. Wall-mounted display showing a scrambled flowchart. One cabinet drawer slightly ajar. Dim overhead lighting with blue security accent lights.
